question: How many words does a person speak in a day?
move: Men and women came out within a few hundred words of each other when it was measured.
hint: Speaking runs at roughly 130 words a minute; the question is how many minutes.
steps: Recorded speech runs about 130 words per minute.
People actually speak for perhaps 2 hours of a waking day.
reference: Mehl, Vazire, Ramírez-Esparza, Slatcher & Pennebaker, Are Women Really More Talkative Than Men?, Science, 2007
